title: Silverstone AI Image Asset Catalogue for Codex
implementation_guidance: Use repository_path as the canonical import/public-file location.
When a path changes, search by prefix_search rather than by the full extension or responsive suffix.
Prefer desktop and mobile as a <picture> pair; the responsive files are purpose-built compositions, not merely compressed duplicates.
Do not layer important webpage copy over images that already contain substantial baked-in copy.
Treat dashboards, metrics, addresses, customer names and performance figures inside these images as illustrative mock data.
For a dark premium Vite design, prioritise assets scoring 9–10 and use lighter assets as contrast sections.
Optimise delivery to AVIF/WebP at build time while retaining the original repository asset as source of truth.

assets.adjacent_page_copy: Our Mission — Silverstone AI helps UK small businesses run with the clarity, consistency, and commercial control of a much larger team. We design practical automation around the way your people already work, so every workflow feels measured, brand-safe, and immediately useful rather than bolted on for the sake of novelty. Our mission is to replace scattered manual tasks with a calmer operating rhythm: faster first response, cleaner handoffs, fewer dropped opportunities, and more time for the work only your team should own. The result is premium in feel but practical in delivery, giving ambitious businesses a stronger foundation for sustainable growth.
visible_text: Bespoke automation designed to accelerate your growth.
assets.visual_description: Bright executive office overlooking a city. A suited male figure faces a large holographic 'Success Engine' made from three glowing concentric process rings.
assets.composition: Human figure at the left edge provides scale; the large circular system occupies the centre-right and creates a strong aspirational hero composition.
assets.palette_style: Premium enterprise futurism with white architecture and cyan/violet/pink holography.
assets.recommended_uses: Mission, growth, transformation, 'how we work' or secondary hero section.
assets.design_risks: The anonymous suited figure and generic city-office setting can feel stock-like. Baked-in slogan limits reuse.

assets.adjacent_page_copy: Our Story — Founded by a team of technologists and entrepreneurs, Silverstone AI was born out of a desire to help small businesses harness the power of automation without the complexity. We saw how inefficient processes, manual tasks and disconnected systems were holding organisations back and decided to build a better way. Today, we partner closely with clients across industries - from professional services and manufacturing to retail and healthcare - to identify bottlenecks, remove friction and implement smart systems that work seamlessly together. Our bespoke approach ensures that every solution fits your business like a glove, delivering measurable results and empowering your people.
visible_text: Bespoke AI systems tailored to your unique business needs.
assets.visual_description: Bright boardroom with a luminous cyan-and-pink automation core connected to industry icons for healthcare, manufacturing and retail.
assets.composition: The network knot is centred and surrounded by labelled industry nodes, with a large clean boardroom creating depth.
assets.palette_style: Bright, refined enterprise-tech illustration with translucent holographic elements.
assets.recommended_uses: About/story, cross-industry capability, bespoke solutions or industry-navigation sections.
assets.design_risks: The manufacturing label broadens the message beyond the current small-business focus. Small node labels are hard to read when reduced.

assets.adjacent_page_copy: Where leads and time leak. When calls hit during service, inboxes pile up overnight, and bookings rely on manual chasing, revenue slips before your team can catch it. Unanswered calls and slow replies cost ready-to-buy leads. Prospects expect a fast answer across phone, forms, and messaging. Manual booking and follow-up creates weak handovers and dropped tasks. No-shows and late cancellations leave gaps you cannot refill fast enough.
assets.visual_description: Dark executive boardroom with a tablet projecting a neon funnel. Multiple enquiry sources flow into a system-capture engine and emerge as secured leads and revenue.
assets.composition: Wide cinematic frame; headline at upper left, funnel and tablet central, city-facing boardroom adding depth. Clear top-to-bottom process narrative.
assets.palette_style: Dark luxury technology with graphite, cyan, violet and magenta light.
assets.recommended_uses: Excellent for lead capture, missed-call recovery, revenue leakage or automation-overview storytelling.
assets.design_risks: Some tiny process labels are decorative rather than reliably readable. Avoid adding competing UI animation over the funnel.

assets.adjacent_page_copy: Start small. Prove ROI. Scale. Each pack fixes one costly bottleneck first, then gives you a clean base to expand without rebuilding from scratch. What every pack includes: Always-on enquiry capture across web, messaging, and phone where relevant. Qualification that routes strong leads and filters noise. Booking, confirmations, and reminders that cut no-shows. Follow-up flows for quotes, viewings, rebookings, and renewals.

assets.adjacent_page_copy: Where instructions slip away. When viewings, calls, and inboxes stack up, buyers and vendors hear from another agent first. Portal leads and calls stack up while the team is out on viewings. Missed calls turn into lost instructions because sellers ring the next agent. Shared inboxes fill with unread buyer, tenant, and landlord messages. Warm leads cool off when out-of-hours follow-up waits until tomorrow.
visible_text: While you’re out viewing, we’re selling.
AI captures every valuation, applicant and portal lead instantly.
Stop losing fees to missed calls

assets.palette_style: Premium light proptech; white, pale cyan, lavender and pink.
assets.recommended_uses: Estate-agent landing page, missed-call recovery, portal lead capture or branch automation.
assets.design_risks: Industry-specific baked-in copy makes it unsuitable outside estate agency. Some status text becomes illegible at small sizes.

visible_text: Turn attendance data into automated retention.

assets.palette_style: Dark fitness-tech with electric cyan, violet and pink.
assets.recommended_uses: Mobile/tablet source for the same section. Member retention, churn risk, attendance analytics or gym automation hero.
assets.design_risks: Dark environment needs careful contrast when embedded in a dark site. Use through <picture> or responsive source selection rather than forcing it into desktop containers.
